_about: Guide screenshots from scripts/site-shots/run.mjs (invented demo server "Maple Hollow"; no real data). Regenerate with: node scripts/site-shots/run.mjs

images.alt: The reply to /setup in Discord: Maple Hollow has 6 of 41 features running, a list of what is on and what is one click away, and a menu to start from a preset.
A go-live post in #stream-alerts: "rowanpike_plays is LIVE on Twitch!", the stream title, the game, and a card with the streamer's name, title and viewer count.
Two feed posts: a new YouTube upload with its title, description and thumbnail, then a Bluesky post from the Maple Hollow account.
A level-up post for Sorrel Quinn reaching level 15 with the Sapling role as a reward, then the rank card Sorrel gets from /level rank.
A welcome post for Wren Alder: a greeting with links to #rules and #roles, and a card with their avatar, "Wren Alder just joined the server" and "Member #1284".
A role panel called Pick your roles with four buttons (Night owls, Artists, Gamers, Stream pings), and the private reply "You now have the Artists role!".
A mod log entry: Warn Issued, with the member, the moderator and the reason.
A lockdown alert: Server Lockdown Started, every new member is kicked until it ends in an hour, started by the auto-trigger after 22 joins in 10 seconds.
The Help desk ticket panel with an Open a ticket button, and the first message in a new private ticket channel with a Close Ticket button.
The AI DJ starting from the prompt "rainy evening lo-fi", then the Now Playing card for the current track with its artist, length, who asked for it and a progress bar.
Two economy replies: Pip claims a daily reward of 250 acorns with a 3-day streak bonus, then checks a balance of 4,450 acorns in the wallet and 12,800 in the bank.
Three posts: a starboard repost of a message with 5 stars, a suggestion with 14 up votes and 2 down votes, and a birthday announcement for Wren Alder.
The reply to /arcade greenhouse status: Thistle's level, cash, benches ready to harvest, the daily reward, quests, season points and the weekly challenge, with an Open the game button.
The private reply to /privacy status: message logging is on, leaderboards are hidden, the last export date, and the four /privacy commands.
A December 2026 stream schedule poster: a month grid with a show and start time on stream days and NO STREAM on the others.
The dashboard server picker: Maple Hollow and three other servers, each card opening that server's settings.
The Maple Hollow overview on the dashboard: member and stream counts, then the setup checklist with two steps left.
The Streamers page: four tracked streamers with their platforms, and the form for adding another.
The Social feeds page: the YouTube section with one channel posting to #new-videos, and the X section below it.
The Leveling page: XP settings, the level-up channel and three role rewards at levels 5, 15 and 30.
A rank card for sorrelq: rank 3, level 18, 1240 of 2100 XP to the next level with the bar at 59 percent, and 24,860 XP in total.
The Welcome page: the welcome channel, the message with placeholders, and the welcome card settings.
The Reaction roles page with one panel, Pick your roles, giving four roles with buttons.
The Moderation page: the mod log channel, an escalation rule and the latest warnings, bans and timeouts.
The AutoMod page with two rules: an anti-spam rule that times members out and a banned words rule that deletes the message.
The Logging page: the server log channel and which events are logged.
The Raid lockdown panel on the dashboard: no lockdown running, and the form to start one with the action for every join, how long it lasts and whether to pause invites.
The Tickets page with one panel, Help desk, posting in #support and opening tickets in the Support tickets category.
The Music page: DJ role, vote skip at 50 percent, playlist limits and the AI DJ voice.
The Economy page: the currency is acorns, the daily reward and work pay, and two items in the shop.
The Starboard page: posts to #starboard once a message has 3 star reactions.
The Birthdays page: announcements in #birthdays with a Birthday role, and three saved birthdays.
The Suggestions page: approval required with a staff review channel, one suggestion waiting for approval and one approved with its votes.
The Greenhouse Tycoon page on the dashboard: the current season, this week's challenge and the Maple Hollow members who play, ranked by season points.
The Schedules page on the dashboard with the Maple Hollow Charity Marathon event and an older one.
The public schedule page for the Maple Hollow Charity Marathon: a table of runs with the game, runners, estimate and status, and the run that is live now.
The Kick Defender page for one channel: the defender switch on, chat connected, ban length, scam-link strikes and the warning message.
The Stream bot overview: a Twitch and a Kick channel linked with the Twitch one live, today's follows, subs, bits, raids and tips, and the live feed of recent events.
The automation editor for Thank followers in chat: the trigger is Follow, a cooldown is counted for each person, and a Send a chat message action thanks the follower by name.
The Connections page: the linked Twitch channel with its Stream bot grant, its event subscriptions and the events it can send, and the linked Kick channel.

The automation editor with an If step that mutes the microphone on the Starting Soon, Be right back and Ending scenes and unmutes it otherwise, then Create a clip, a chat announcement with the clip link, and a title change on Twitch and Kick.

The Timers page: a Socials timer with two messages taking turns every 20 minutes on Twitch and Kick, only while live and after 10 chat lines, a Stretch break timer that is off, and a timer from the Kick channel page.

The Overlays tab: an alert box, a chat overlay, a follower goal at 64 of 100, a Deaths counter and a recent events list, each with whether it is open in OBS, the kinds of overlay to add, and the images and videos uploaded for alerts.
An alert box's page: its private browser-source address with Copy and New address, a live preview showing a Bits alert, and a Test button for each alert type.
The alert box in OBS over a scene: MapleFan_88 threw 1,000 Bits, with an image and the viewer's message under it, and a Deaths: 13 text in the top right corner from an automation.
CertiFried Studio's Hotkeys tab with demo data: Ctrl+Shift+F1 runs the BRB automation, F13 plays Airhorn.mp3, Ctrl+Alt+M mutes or unmutes the Mic, and a form to add a hotkey.

CertiFried Studio's Status tab with demo data: connected to CertiFried and to OBS 31 on 127.0.0.1 port 4455, the scene on air, and recent actions, OBS events and hotkeys, one of them failed because a source was missing.
